proposition: Other members of his Yazd-phase circle include Qivām al-Dīn Muḥammad (d. 830/1427), Sharaf al-Dīn's brother, who appears to have taken the takhalluṣ Ṣāʾinī out of veneration for him, and Mawlānā Rukn al-Dīn Ṣāʿid Kirmānī, for whom he wrote a brief commentary on a hadith.

mediation.who: Richard, 'Un témoignage inexploité', and a note in MS Majlis 10196 f. 122a
mediation.note: MK: 'appears to'; Kirmānī's membership is only 'suggested'
